sloka: तस्य सत्याभिसन्धस्य वृद्धस्य वचनात् पितुः ।सभार्यः सह च भ्रात्रा वीरः प्रव्राजितो वनम् ।। ५.३१.८।।।।
transliteration: tasya satyābhisandhasya vṛddhasya vacanāt pituḥ ।sabhāryaḥ saha ca bhrātrā vīraḥ pravrājito vanam ।। 5.31.8।।।।

translations.english: "Honouring the word of his aged father who was ever steadfast in truth, Rama left for the forest along with his wife and brother.
